messages:
alex: Following up on the late-night postmortem — we identified a recurring pattern: brief p99 spikes correlated with shard rebalances during autoscale. Need owners, precise timelines, and SLO/SLA wording updates.

priya: Thanks. I'll take ownership of the autoscale config audit. Plan: reproduce in staging, gather heatmap of sequence lengths by shard, and propose autoscale cooldown changes. ETA 7 business days.

dave: I'll handle the runtime changes for KV cache eviction behavior. Quick fix: lower aggression for cold-shard evictions; longer term: refactor eviction policy. Short-term PR in ~10 days.

zoe: I'll own the SLA wording and dashboard rollouts. Proposal: add a throughput SLO (p95 requests/sec per shard) and change text-gen p99 SLA to a 30-day rolling window with a 5% error budget monthly. Need legal sign-off for SLA copy.

alex: For clarity: current p99 SLA is 350ms. Zoe, what's the proposed numeric change?

zoe: Suggest temporary p99 target = 300ms for public text-gen route while we stabilize. Also add throughput SLO: p95 >= 120 qps per shard during business hours. We'll gate the temporary SLO on two things: dashboards+alerts in prod, and a rollback policy.

priya: On rollback: recommend automatic fallback routing to autoscale-safe shard pool if p99 > 600ms for 3m or throughput drops > 30% for 5m. Add a manual abort step for canaries.

ops-bot: Created ticket SRE-6123: "pm/followup/autoscale-eviction-and-slo-update" with checklist template.

dave: Draft PromQL for p99 spike alert (5m eval):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.36
```
This triggers when p99 > 360ms. We'll tune thresholds after staging runs.

zoe: Draft throughput SLO query (business hours filter):
```
avg_over_time(sum(rate(requests_total{route="text-gen"}[5m])) by (shard)[30d:1d]) > 120
```
I'll add panels for shard-level qps and a 7-day rolling error-budget burn chart.

alex: Milestones: audit plan by 1995123556 (24h), dashboard + alerts in prod by 1995200000 (5 days), autoscale PR opened by 1995787656 (10 days), KV eviction PR by 1996399999 (14 days). Please add these to SRE-6123.

priya: Added milestones and linked the staging run notebook. Will ping once I have a replayable test.

dave: I'll include an integration test that simulates shard rebalance in CI. Flagging potential perf regression risk — will coordinate with runtime bench infra.

zoe: I'll draft the temporary SLA amendment and route to legal for review. Also creating a 3-week cadence for post-deploy incident reviews to watch for recurrence.

alex: Thanks all. Final ask: each owner update the ticket with exact rollback criteria and the signal(s) that count as SLA violation. I'll approve the temporary SLO once dashboards + rollback logic are in place. :white_check_mark:
